Comment: Downloads a raw CSV file, imports it through the CSV import endpoint (the file-reading process), then aggregates orders per region in DuckDB.

FetchCsvFile.Comment: GET /api/fake/csv/sample?rows=20&seed=3 - raw CSV file, arrives as $.body string.

ImportCsv.Comment: POSTs the downloaded CSV text to the import endpoint; response rows are type-coerced.

AggregateOrders.Comment: Loads the imported rows into DuckDB table 'orders' and totals amount per region.

Parameters.sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM orders GROUP BY region ORDER BY total_amount DESC

ValidatePipeline.Comment: The pipeline must produce at least one aggregated row.

ValidationFailed.Cause: CSV import pipeline produced no aggregated rows
